annotations.title: Choose a Zalo channel for a task

description: Suggest which Zalo channel fits a business task, by simple published rules: ZBS template message (with the template type, tag, price and window), a free consultation reply within 48 hours of the user's last interaction (paid outside 48 hours, not allowed after 7 days), an OA broadcast to followers, or a Mini App. Tasks: otp, order_status, delivery_tracking, payment_request, appointment_reminder, customer_reply, service_rating, promotion, voucher, birthday_greeting, news_to_followers, catalog_checkout. Optional: last_interaction_hours, is_follower. Reference only. Examples: {"task":"order_status"}; {"task":"customer_reply","last_interaction_hours":30}; {"task":"promotion","is_follower":true}.

last_interaction_hours.description: Hours since the user's last interaction with the OA (message, call, menu tap...). Decides whether a free reply is possible.

task.description: What you need to send: otp, order_status, delivery_tracking, payment_request, appointment_reminder, customer_reply, service_rating, promotion, voucher, birthday_greeting, news_to_followers, catalog_checkout.
